# ISO metadata fixture

This is independently curated catalog metadata, not ISO clause text or an approved requirement.

ISO/IEC 27001 concerns information security management systems.
Official metadata: https://www.iso.org/standard/27001

ISO 14001 concerns environmental management systems.
Official metadata: https://www.iso.org/standard/60857.html

Full standards require an appropriate license. Place authorized documents in a private source directory.
